messages:
maya chung: Heads-up — noticed a weird jump in per-model unit cost for /chat/compose last night despite total token volume falling. My hunch: cache savings are being applied at the model level, not attributed to the calling route. Can we confirm? :thinking_face:

thomas r.: Yep this is deliberate today — KV/cache hits emit model_id only, the batcher doesn't tag route_id. That makes global savings easier but hides per-route econ. We can change but it touches the hot path.

leo b.: If we add route_id to the cache metadata we can emit cheap 'cache_credit' events on hit. Minimal overhead: attach route_id hash (4 bytes) to KV entries and increment a counter. Example event shape we could emit from runtime:
```
{ "event": "cache_credit", "model": "rw-llm-x", "route": "route_123", "saved_tokens": 42 }
```
Then dashboard SQL can roll up per-route savings.

maya chung: That sounds reasonable. Is there risk of cardinality explosion for routes? Some customers create lots of dynamic routes.

thomas r.: Good call. We'll cap unique route tags to top N per tenant (configurable) and fallback to 'other'. Also need a backfill plan for historic data.

billing-bot: Auto-estimate: if we re-attribute cache_savings by route for last 30d, approx $12.1k/month shifts from "shared" to top-5 routes for tenant acme-inc. Numbers are rough. :chart_with_upwards_trend: 

sara: UX note — showing per-route unit cost without sampling windows will look like noise. Suggest showing a 7/14/30 day smoothing toggle and marking new metric as BETA with tooltip explaining attribution method.

ops-bot: Suggest rollout plan: feature-flag telemetry v2 + dashboard toggle. Canary to 10% tenants, monitor delta on unit-cost variance and billing diff. Add alert if >25% shift for any tenant.

maya chung: Sounds like a plan. thomas, can you sketch an RFC with changes to runtime, telemetry schema, db migrations, and backfill? Include perf microbench. If small, we try to push in 2 sprints behind flag. :rocket:

thomas r.: I'll draft RFC today and post in #eng-platform RFCs. Quick TODOs: 1) runtime: tag KV entries with route hash, emit cache_credit events; 2) pipeline: update ingestion + event schema (v2); 3) warehouse: add route_cache_savings table + backfill job; 4) dashboard: new attribution view + smoothing options; 5) rollout: feature flag + canary. ETA 2 sprints for MVP.

leo b.: One more thought — for fairness we should subtract cache credits before quota enforcement when showing per-route unit cost, otherwise teams see misleading 'spent' numbers.

sara: Agreed. Also we should surface a 'confidence' score per route so teams know when attribution is sparse.

maya chung: Great. Leave a note if any of the migration steps require downtime or tenant coordination.

thomas r.: Will do. I'll include metrics we should watch during canary (avg tokens saved per request, variance in per-route unit cost, ingestion lag).

billing-bot: Scheduled job queued: run small backfill sample for tenant acme-inc (last 7d) — will post results in thread when done.

maya chung: Awesome, thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
